meta.title: Multi-bus phasor tool — representative NZ 220 kV → 400 V radial cascade
meta.hat: Gridlytics / public physics (generic, representative values; no confidential specifics)
model_note: Single 'equivalent GXP feeder': one representative path from the grid down to the
customer LV bus, with each level's parallel plant aggregated (series Z divided,
shunt charging multiplied) so the whole path carries a realistic GXP's worth of
load and cable charging. Aggregation tree from transit_ladder.py: 4 zone subs x 4
feeders/zone x 6 DTx/feeder = 96 DTx. This makes the transmission-to-LV physics
visible on a single string; it is NOT a literal single 500 kVA transformer.
A hidden ideal slack ('GRID') sits behind a grid Thevenin reactance so the 220 kV
bus (B1) responds to reactive injection/absorption — that is what lets the STATCOM
demonstration ('the 220 kV comes down') actually move the 220 kV voltage.

sources.transmission: tools/models/ac-powerflow (PSS/E-derived NZ grid; real Albany-Silverdale 220 kV + SVL/ALB 220/33 transformers). System base 100 MVA.
sources.distribution: research/distribution-kb + clients/ea/power-factor/lib/transit_ladder.py (DH-reviewed 13 Jul 2026 'about right') + standard NZ/IEC cable & transformer data.
sources.voltage_limits: Electricity (Safety) Regulations reg 28: 230 V nominal, +/-10% (from 13 Nov 2025, SL 2025/225) = 207-253 V; was +/-6% = 216.2-243.8 V.

buses.name: 220 kV bus (device: STATCOM / reactor)
buses.note: Bs is the shunt device (STATCOM/reactor). Bs<0 absorbs vars (reactor/STATCOM-absorb); Bs>0 injects (cap). Default off.

buses.name: Customer LV bus (230 V) — load + LV cable C
buses.note: Aggregate GXP load lives here. Leading (capacitive) customer equipment is represented by Q<0. Bs is small residual LV cable charging.

branches.name: Grid Thevenin (system strength)
branches.source: System short-circuit strength at a 220 kV bus ~2.5 GVA fault level -> Z=100/2500=0.04 pu; X/R~10. Representative (ac-powerflow population). This is what makes B1 (220 kV) move when the device injects/absorbs Q.

branches.name: 220 kV short line (GXP incomer)
branches.source: Short 220 kV incomer. transit_ladder.py:83 (0.002+j0.015). Charging b=0.0187 pu from real Albany-Silverdale 220 kV line (ac-powerflow North_Island_peak_winter_2024.raw:962). X/R=7.5.

branches.name: 220/33 kV GXP transformer (OLTC)
branches.source: 2x60 MVA 220/33, X=12% each -> 0.10 pu net on 100 MVA (transit_ladder.py:86). Real SVL-TF-T1 is 16% on 100 MVA, X/R~45. OLTC on HV side, range 0.85-1.075 pu, 1.25% steps (real SVL/ALB, ac-powerflow raw:2386). Regulates 33 kV bus to 1.03 pu (transit_ladder SET_33). Raising HV tap lowers the LV bus.

branches.name: 33 kV cable (aggregate x4 zone feeders)
branches.source: 8 km 630 Al 33 kV cable, single = 0.044+j0.081 pu, b=0.00493 pu (R=0.06/X=0.11 ohm/km, C=0.18 uF/km, Zb=10.89 ohm; transit_ladder.py:88, distribution-kb d4). Aggregated over 4 parallel zone feeders: series/4, charging x4. X/R=1.84 (still X-dominated).

branches.name: 33/11 kV zone transformer (OLTC)
branches.source: 2x23 MVA 33/11, single zone = 0.008+j0.217 pu (X=10% each, X/R~27; transit_ladder.py:92). Aggregated over 4 zones: /4 = 0.002+j0.0543. OLTC +/-15% in 1.25% steps (NZ zone subs). Regulates 11 kV bus to 1.02 pu (transit_ladder SET_11).

branches.name: 11 kV feeder (aggregate x16)
branches.source: 4 km 240 Al 11 kV feeder, single = 0.5+j0.3 pu, b=0.00038 pu (R=0.16/X=0.08 ohm/km, C=0.25 uF/km, Zb=1.21 ohm; transit_ladder.py:94, distribution-kb d4). Aggregated over 16 feeders: series/16, charging x16. R/X=1.67 -> THE FLIP: resistance now dominates. NOTE: transit_ladder rounds single X up to 0.3 pu; the raw ohm/km give 0.529+j0.264 (X/R=0.50 vs 0.60 here) - the flip holds either way, the rounding is conservative against the thesis.

branches.name: 11/0.4 kV distribution transformer (fixed +2.5% boost)
branches.source: 500 kVA 11/0.4, single = 2.2+j8.8 pu (Z~4.5%, X/R~4; transit_ladder.py:98). Aggregated over 96 DTx: /96 = 0.0229+j0.0917. Fixed OFF-LOAD tap set to +2.5% boost -> ratio 0.975 (= -2 x 1.25% steps; transit_ladder DTX_BOOST). No OLTC.

branches.name: LV feeder (400/230 V, R-dominated)
branches.source: Aggregate LV feeder. Standard NZ LV cable (185 mm2 Al): R~0.164/X~0.075 ohm/km, R/X~2-5. Derivation: single ~30 m drop = 0.03*(0.164+j0.075) ohm... referred, single run ~ 3.1+j1.4 pu on 0.4 kV (Zb=0.0016 ohm); aggregated over ~96 DTx x 4 LV runs = 384 -> 0.008+j0.004, but LV load is distributed not end-lumped, so we use a heavier representative equivalent 0.040+j0.012 pu (R/X=3.3) to carry the full aggregate LV drop. This is the least directly-auditable element (representative, order-of-magnitude); it delivers the strongly R-dominated LV and completes the flip.

rx_flip_table.note: The reactance->resistance flip is a property of the LINE / CABLE / FEEDER conductor segments. Their per-km R/X is an INPUT choice (X/R is invariant under the parallel-N aggregation: divide-by-N cancels), so the flip is set by the conductor data, not discovered by the solve. The three transformers interleaved in the same cascade stay strongly X-dominated throughout (see 'transformers' below), so the real bus-to-bus series impedance is non-monotonic. The flip is a statement about the conductor segments.

scenarios._scale_note: Loads sized to the 96-DTx aggregate (96 x 0.5 MVA = 48 MVA capacity): a representative ~40 MVA GXP. Day peak = 39.8 MVA = 0.83 of capacity; overnight leading is the overvoltage regime.

day_peak.label: Day peak (lagging)
day_peak.note: PF~0.95 lag, S=hypot(38,12)=39.8 MVA = 0.83 of the 48 MVA aggregate DTx capacity; series drops dominate.

overnight.label: Overnight min (leading)
overnight.note: SVL-type night: 18 MW, 11 MVAr leading (PF~0.85 lead). Cable + LED/SMPS. The overvoltage regime.

overnight_x.label: Overnight, heavy cable
overnight_x.note: Very light load, more leading Q — pushes OLTCs toward tap-out and the LV floats up.

statcom_demo.label: Overnight + 220 kV reactor
statcom_demo.note: Reactor/STATCOM at B1, B=-1.0 pu = 100 MVAr NOMINAL (at 1.0 pu); a fixed shunt absorbs B*V^2, so ~93 MVAr at the depressed 0.966 pu bus. 220 kV comes down, LV held by OLTCs (the load-bearing demonstration). A V-regulating STATCOM (constant MVAr) is Phase 3.
